proposals.title: Proposal to Publish an Annual Report Disclosing Lobbying Activities
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Pension Plans Master Trust (SEIU)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing company lobbying policies, payments to lobbying recipients including trade associations, and oversight processes for such payments.
proposals.evidence: The board, after review by its Directors and Corporate Governance Committee, recommends a vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Eliminate Supermajority Voting Requirements
proposals.topic_summary: Requests replacing every voting requirement above simple majority in the charter and bylaws with a majority of votes cast, with extensive solicitation and EDGAR filing steps.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that the company's shareholders oppose this proposal and instead adopt management's proposal

proposals.title: Proposal to Establish and Report on a Process by which the Impact of Extended Patent Exclusivities on Product Access Would be Considered in Deciding Whether to Apply for Secondary and Tertiary Patents
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to establish and report on a process considering how extended patent exclusivities affect product access before applying for secondary and tertiary patents.
proposals.evidence: The board, after review by its Directors and Corporate Governance Committee, recommends a vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Report on Risks of Supporting Abortion
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on known risks and costs from opposing or altering company policy regarding state abortion regulations and mitigation strategies.
proposals.evidence: The board, after review by its Directors and Corporate Governance Committee, recommends a vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Disclose Lobbying Activities and Alignment with Public Policy Positions and Statements
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a third-party review of how Lilly reconciles innovation and patient access commitments with its lobbying and policy advocacy, direct and through trade associations.
proposals.evidence: The board, after review by its Directors and Corporate Governance Committee, recommends a vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Report on Effectiveness of the Company's Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Efforts
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on DEI effectiveness using quantitative hiring, retention, and promotion metrics broken down by gender, race, and ethnicity.
proposals.evidence: The board, after review by its Directors and Corporate Governance Committee, recommends a vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Adopt a Policy to Require Certain Third-Party Organizations to Annually Report Expenditures for Political Activities before Lilly Contributes to an Organization
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring trade associations and social welfare groups to report annually their political expenditures before receiving Lilly contributions, with reports posted publicly.
proposals.evidence: The board, after review by its Directors and Corporate Governance Committee, recommends a vote against this proposal.
